title: AI Engineer — Generative AI & Agentic AI
jobDescription: In Time Tec is an award-winning IT & software company. In Time Tec offers progressive software development services, enabling its clients to keep their brightest and most valuable talent focused on innovation. In Time Tec has a leadership team averaging 15 years in software/firmware R&D, and 20 years building onshore/offshore R&D teams. We are looking for rare talent to join us. People having a positive mindset and great organizational skills will be drawn to the position. Your capacity to take initiative and solve problems as they emerge, flexibility, and honesty, will be key factors for your success at In Time Tec. About the Role We are looking for engineers to build next-generation AI systems powered by Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures . This role focuses on developing intelligent systems that can reason, act, and automate complex workflows using large language models and multi-agent frameworks. You will work on designing and delivering production-grade AI solutions , including conversational systems, document intelligence, decision automation, and AI-driven applications. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals along with hands-on experience in building, integrating, and scaling AI systems beyond prototypes. Key Responsibilities Design and implement agentic AI systems , including multi-agent workflows, orchestration logic, and tool-integrated agents Build Generative AI applications using LLMs for use cases such as conversational AI, content generation, and intelligent automation Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases and semantic search techniques Integrate and work with multiple LLMs and AI models , selecting and optimizing them based on performance, cost, and use case requirements Design and develop scalable backend systems and APIs to support AI applications Implement prompt engineering strategies , structured outputs, and guardrails to improve model reliability Evaluate, monitor, and optimise AI system performance, including accuracy, latency, and cost efficiency Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into AI-driven solutions Stay updated with advancements in Gen AI, agentic frameworks, and emerging AI tooling Contribute to system documentation, architecture discussions, and knowledge sharing across teams Skills Required Core Skills Strong programming skills in Python (and familiarity with backend frameworks) Hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLMs in real-world applications Experience with RAG architectures , embeddings, and document processing pipelines Familiarity with agentic frameworks (such as Lang Chain, Lang Graph, Crew AI, or similar) Understanding of API design, system architecture, and scalable backend development Experience with vector databases (e.g., Qdrant, Weaviate, FAISS, or similar) Solid understanding of prompt engineering, model behaviour, and output control techniques Good to Have Experience with multi-agent systems and workflow orchestration Exposure to knowledge graphs or hybrid retrieval systems Familiarity with cloud platforms and containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) Experience in evaluation frameworks, monitoring tools, and model optimisation techniques Understanding of voice-based systems (STT/TTS) or multimodal AI applications Behavioural & Engineering Mindset Strong problem-solving ability with a focus on building scalable, production-ready systems Ability to work in fast-paced and ambiguous environments Ownership mindset with attention to quality, performance, and reliability Clear communication and ability to collaborate across teams How You’ll Grow at In Time Tec In Time Tec , has made significant investments to create a stimulating environment for its people to grow. We want each of our employees to grow in their way and play their roles while honing their ownership abilities. As part of those efforts, we provide our professionals with a range of educational opportunities to help them grow in their career. Our guiding principles of leadership, trust, transparency, and integrity serve as the foundation for everything we do and every success we achieve. We are proud of these fundamental principles since they demonstrate our dedication towards them as a “One Team”. We value every individual by giving them the freedom to make daily decisions that can support their health, well-being, confidence, and awareness. Our leadership team is there to offer the safe base by giving the right budding environment, instruction, tools, and chances necessary for your professional development in achieving your goals. Our people and culture work together in a collaborative environment, making In Time Tec a thriving place to work. You can find out more about Life at In Time Tec here. jobDescription:
In Time Tec is an award-winning IT & software company. In Time Tec offers progressive software development services, enabling its clients to keep their brightest and most valuable talent focused on innovation. In Time Tec has a leadership team averaging 15 years in software/firmware R&D, and 20 years building onshore/offshore R&D teams. We are looking for a rare talent to join us. People who have a positive mindset and great organizational skills will be drawn to the position. Your capacity to take initiative and solve problems as they emerge, flexibility, and honesty will be key factors for your success at In Time Tec. Job Overview: We are looking for a skilled and motivated C++ Developer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will play a key part in designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance software solutions for Smart Stream Composer. Job Description: Proficient in architecting solutions for complex embedded applications. Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in development in C/C++. Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in embedded hardware systems and protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, DMA, LTDC, STM32) Experience and ability to define, analyze and document complex requirements. Understanding of SOLID Principles and design patterns. Proven experience in embedded systems design with pre-emptive, multitasking real-time operating systems (Free RTOS) Experience in collaborating with global stakeholders for product development Ability to coach and mentor the talent on development best practices Ability to understand and work with technical complexities across different programming languages and frameworks. Lead end-to-end project initiatives by creating JIRA stories, defining acceptance criteria, and making the best use of the Atlassian suite. Skills Required: C, C++, Embedded protocols. Software Design Concepts Git Agile Development Methodologies Good analytical, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills. Should be a good problem solver and quick learner. Should have excellent communication, presentation, and client management skills. Experience leading a team of at least

title: DevOps Engineer
jobDescription:
In Time Tec is an award-winning IT & software company. In Time Tec offers progressive software development services, enabling its clients to keep their brightest and most valuable talent focused on innovation. In Time Tec has a leadership team averaging 15 years in software/firmware R&D, and 20 years building onshore/offshore R&D teams. We are looking for rare talent to join us. People having a positive mindset and great organizational skills will be drawn to the position. Your capacity to take initiative and solve problems as they emerge, flexibility, and honesty, will be key factors for your success at In Time Tec. Job Overview: The position requires an experienced and ambitious candidate who is passionate about technology and self-driven. We have an energetic workplace where we welcome innovative ideas and offer growth opportunities and a positive environment for accomplishing goals. Our purpose is to create abundance for everyone we touch. Responsibilities of the role include: Design, automate, and manage infrastructure provisioning across AWS, Azure, and Open Stack environments using Infrastructure as Code (Cloud Formation, Azure Resource Manager, Terraform, Terragrunt). Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, reliable, and repeatable application delivery. Proactive Monitoring of overall infrastructure (Logs/Resources etc). Deploy, operate, and scale Kubernetes clusters for container orchestration, ensuring high availability and optimal resource utilization. Deploy applications across multiple cloud environments (dev, staging, production) with zero-downtime strategies. Implement proactive monitoring, logging, and alerting across infrastructure and applications (logs, metrics, resource utilization). Lead and mentor team members, driving them toward project goals and defined milestones. Practice and implement best practices in every aspect of project deliverable. Review and design solution architecture
- both high-level and detailed
- for cloud-based systems. Evaluate new cloud products and services, assess their architectural impact, and recommend adoption where appropriate. Stay current with emerging tools and frameworks and enable the team to adopt them effectively. Skills Required: 2+ years of hands-on Dev Ops/Cloud experience. Strong expertise in AWS and Azure (Open Stack exposure is a plus), including cloud-native automation tools such as AWS Cloud Formation and Azure Resource Manager (ARM/Bicep). Experience in Automation of CI/CD processes using tools such as GIT, Jenkins, Circle CI, Azure Pipeline, Gitlab. Manage containerized applications using Docker, ensuring optimal performance and resource utilization. Proven experience deploying, managing, and troubleshooting production Kubernetes clusters (EKS/AKS preferred). Hands-on experience with Terraform and Terragrunt; familiarity with configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet, Power Shell DSC). Strong proficiency in Python and Power Shell; working knowledge of Shell/Bash. Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk, Nagios, or Zabbix. Web Server/Application Server deployments and administration. Good Communication, Team Handling, Problem-solving, Work Ethic and Creativity. Experience leading cloud migration, data integration, and consolidation from traditional (on-prem) to cloud data structures. Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to handle multiple tasks under tight deadlines. Good-to-Have Skills Experience deploying AI/ML models and AI services on cloud platforms (AWS Sage Maker, Azure ML, Azure Open AI, AWS Bedrock). Familiarity with LLM inference and serving frameworks such as v LLM, TGI, or Triton Inference Server. Experience with GPU-based workloads on Kubernetes (node pools, autoscaling, resource scheduling for inference). Exposure to MLOps practices and pipelines. Qualification Required: Candidates with B.Tech or M Tech degree are preferred. Must have Associate and above level certifications . If you do not have certification, please do not apply. jobDescription: In Time Tec is an award-winning IT & software company. In Time Tec offers progressive software development services, enabling its clients to keep their brightest and most valuable talent focused on innovation. In Time Tec has a leadership team averaging 16 years in software/firmware R&D, and 20 years building onshore/offshore R&D teams. We are looking for rare talent to join us. People having a positive mindset and great organizational skills will be drawn to the position. Your capacity to take initiative and solve problems as they emerge, flexibility, and honesty, will be key factors for your success at In Time Tec. About the Role, We are looking for a proactive and technically skilled Infrastructure Engineer – Backup, Disaster Recovery & Virtualization with 2–3 years of hands-on experience in enterprise backup solutions, disaster recovery, virtualization, Windows infrastructure, and cloud platforms. The ideal candidate should have practical experience managing Acronis Cyber Protect, VMware, Hyper-V, virtual machine backup and recovery, Windows Server administration, and Microsoft 365 environments. This role requires strong troubleshooting skills, backup validation, disaster recovery testing, and infrastructure support to ensure business continuity and high system availability. Candidates with experience in Acronis Backup, VMware v Sphere, Hyper-V, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Azure, AWS, and enterprise storage technologies will be preferred. Key Responsibilities Backup & Disaster Recovery • Install, configure, and administer Acronis Cyber Protect Backup solutions. • Configure backup policies for physical servers, virtual machines, endpoints, Microsoft 365, and cloud workloads. • Monitor daily backup jobs and proactively resolve backup failures. • Perform file-level, image-level, VM-level, application-aware, and bare-metal recovery. • Conduct periodic backup verification and restoration testing. • Plan and execute Disaster Recovery (DR) drills and failover testing. • Maintain Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) and Recovery Time Objectives (RTO). • Configure backup retention policies and lifecycle management. • Manage backup repositories, storage optimization, compression, and deduplication. • Maintain disaster recovery documentation, SOPs, and recovery procedures. • Ensure backup infrastructure complies with organizational security standards. Microsoft 365 Administration • Administer Microsoft 365 tenant and core services. • Manage Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, Share Point Online, and One Drive. • Create and manage users, groups, mailboxes, and Microsoft 365 licenses. • Configure Microsoft Entra ID users, authentication, and Conditional Access policies. • Support Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) implementation. • Assist in Microsoft Intune endpoint enrolment and device management. • Support Microsoft 365 backup and recovery where applicable. Endpoint Management • Manage Windows 10 and Windows 11 devices using Microsoft Intune. • Configure Bit Locker, Windows Update for Business, compliance policies, and endpoint security. • Deploy applications and security configurations. • Troubleshoot endpoint issues and monitor device health. Infrastructure Monitoring • Monitor backup success rates, infrastructure availability, virtualization performance, storage utilization, CPU, memory, and network resources. • Perform proactive health checks and preventive maintenance. • Generate infrastructure and backup health reports. Incident & Change Management. • Troubleshoot infrastructure, virtualization, backup, storage, server, and cloud-related incidents. • Manage incidents using ITSM tools. • Handle escalations and coordinate with OEM vendors. • Participate in planned maintenance and change management activities. Documentation .Prepare infrastructure documentation, backup architecture diagrams, and disaster recovery documentation. • Maintain SOPs, knowledge base articles, recovery procedures, and asset inventory. • Document backup policies, recovery workflows, and virtualization environments. title: ML Engineer – Computer Vision Engineer
jobDescription: In Time Tec is an award-winning IT & software company. In Time Tec offers progressive software development services, enabling its clients to keep their brightest and most valuable talent focused on innovation. In Time Tec has a leadership team averaging 16 years in software/firmware R&D, and 20 years building onshore/offshore R&D teams. We are looking for rare talent to join us. People having a positive mindset and great organizational skills will be drawn to the position. Your capacity to take initiative and solve problems as they emerge, flexibility, and honesty, will be key factors for your success at In Time Tec. Location: Bangalore / Jaipur Our Mission at In Time Tec At In Time Tec, we believe in creating abundance through trust, transparency, and long-term partnerships. As a global technology company, we empower businesses to transform digitally with scalable software solutions, strategic consulting, and a people-first approach. With a presence across Europe, US, Australia, Arabia and Asia, In Time Tec has delivered over 1000 successful projects across industries. We're looking for you… We’re building a future where technology creates abundance—for businesses, communities, and individuals. Seeking an Engineer with expertise in Computer Vision, Python, and ML frameworks to develop impactful, scalable solutions in a purpose-driven environment. If you're ready to grow, lead, and build the future—apply now and let’s create something meaningful together. Job Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Computer Vision Engineer specialising in real-time detection, pose estimation, and movement analysis to design and deliver robust vision-based intelligence systems. The role focuses on building scalable pipelines capable of detecting people and objects, analysing human movement patterns, and tracking individuals across frames in real-world environments. This position will play a critical role in developing production-grade systems that operate reliably across varying lighting conditions, camera angles, occlusions, and live video feeds, ensuring consistent performance in real deployment scenarios. Key Responsibilities Design and implement real-time computer vision pipelines for person and object detection. Develop advanced pose estimation and movement analysis models to interpret body posture, gestures, and motion patterns. Build multi-object tracking systems to accurately track individuals across frames and maintain identity persistence over time. Optimise models for low-latency inference suitable for edge and near-edge deployments. Ensure system robustness across diverse environmental conditions, including varying lighting, occlusions, and camera perspectives. Integrate computer vision models with video ingestion, streaming, and processing frameworks. Perform model evaluation and benchmarking using real-world datasets and live feeds. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align vision models with business use cases and operational requirements. Continuously improve detection accuracy and tracking stability using state-of-the-art techniques. Skills & Qualifications Strong expertise in Computer Vision and Deep Learning techniques is required. The candidate should have hands-on experience with object detection approaches such as YOLO, Faster R-CNN, and SSD; pose estimation frameworks such as Open Pose, HRNet, and Media Pipe; and multi-object tracking methods such as Deep SORT, Byte Track, and OC-SORT. The role requires proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as Py Torch or Tensor Flow, along with experience in real-time video processing pipelines using Open CV, GStreamer, or FFmpeg. Location: Bangalore / Jaipur We're looking for you… We’re building a future where technology creates abundance—for businesses, communities, and individuals. Seeking an Engineer with expertise in Time Series Forecasting, Python, and ML frameworks to develop impactful, scalable solutions in a purpose-driven environment. If you're ready to grow, lead, and build the future—apply now and let’s create something meaningful together.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop and implement Time Series Forecasting models and related algorithms to solve business problems. Design, build, and maintain scalable forecasting systems and infrastructure. Collaborate with architects, software engineers, and product managers to integrate AI solutions into products and services. Monitor and optimize the performance of Forecasting models and systems; making need-based adjustments, to address The Drift. Troubleshoot and debug Forecasting-related issues in collaboration with cross-functional teams. Ensure the ethical use of AI technologies and compliance with industry standards. Skills / Practical Experience: Python. Handling of Missing Values in Time Series, Dealing with Outliers, Scaling and Normalization, Variance Stabilization. Partial Auto-correlation (PACF), Rolling Correlation. Additive and Multiplicatice Decomposition. N-BEATS & Neural Prophet, FB Prophet. Time Series Clustering using Hierarchical Clustering / DBSCAN. title: React Native Developer
jobDescription: We are looking for a passionate and skilled React Native Developer with 2–3 years of hands-on experience to join our mobile engineering team. In this role, you will build and maintain high-quality cross-platform mobile applications that serve thousands of users every day. You will collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver seamless mobile experiences on both i OS and Android. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using React Native for i OS and Android. Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement pixel-perfect, responsive, and accessible interfaces. Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party SDKs (push notifications, analytics, payments, etc.). Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code; participate in peer code reviews. Debug, profile, and optimize app performance — memory, frame rate, and load times. Work with native modules (Objective-C / Swift / Kotlin / Java) when React Native alone is insufficient. Contribute to architectural discussions and help establish best practices within the mobile team. Monitor crash reports and production issues; triage and resolve defects promptly. Keep up with the latest React Native releases and the broader mobile ecosystem. Maintain thorough documentation for components, APIs, and deployment procedures. Required Qualifications Technical Skills 2–3 years of professional experience building production-grade React Native applications. Strong proficiency in Java Script (ES6+) and Type Script. Solid understanding of React fundamentals: hooks, context, component lifecycle, and state management (Redux / Zustand / Mob X). Experience with React Navigation and deep-linking patterns. Hands-on experience consuming REST APIs and managing async data flows. Familiarity with native build toolchains: Xcode, Android Studio, Gradle, Cocoa Pods. Proficiency with version control (Git), branching strategies, and code-review workflows. Experience writing unit and integration tests (Jest, React Native Testing Library). Soft Skills & Work Style Clear written and verbal communication; able to discuss technical trade-offs with non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable working in an agile/scrum environment with two-week sprints. Strong problem-solving mindset and attention to detail. Self-motivated and able to manage tasks independently while knowing when to escalate blockers. Nice to Have Experience with Expo or Expo Go for rapid prototyping. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for mobile (Fastlane, Bitrise, Git Hub Actions). Familiarity with app store submission processes (App Store Connect, Google Play Console). Have deployed at least 1 app on Google Play or App Store. Prior exposure to Graph QL (Apollo Client or similar). Experience integrating analytics tools (Firebase, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Glitchtip). Contributions to open-source React Native libraries or community plugins. Background in web development (React.js) enabling code sharing strategies. AI Tools & Developer Productivity We embrace AI-assisted development as part of our engineering culture. Candidates who are comfortable leveraging AI tools to write, review, and improve code are strongly encouraged to apply. We expect developers at this level to use AI thoughtfully — accelerating output without compromising code quality or security. Expected Proficiency Use AI coding assistants (Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Codeium, or similar) to accelerate boilerplate generation, component scaffolding, and unit test authoring. Leverage AI chat tools (Chat GPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor) for debugging, code explanation, and exploring architectural trade-offs. Prompt AI tools effectively to produce idiomatic React Native / Type Script code, then critically review and refine the output. Use AI-assisted tools for writing and improving documentation, changelogs, and PR descriptions. Responsible & Quality-Conscious Use Validate all AI-generated code for correctness, performance, and security before committing — do not ship unreviewed AI output. Recognize the limitations of AI tools: hallucinations, outdated APIs, and security anti-patterns; apply judgment accordingly. Never share proprietary code, user data, or secrets with external AI services unless approved by the security team. Maintain awareness of open-source license implications when using AI-generated code snippets. Continuous Learning with AI Use AI tools to stay current with React Native ecosystem updates, new libraries, and deprecations. Explore AI-powered testing tools to improve test coverage and catch regressions earlier in the development cycle. Share learnings, effective prompts, and AI workflow improvements with the broader engineering team. title: Senior Network Administrator
jobDescription:
Position Summary: We are currently seeking a Network Administrator to work within the engineering team to serve our growing client base in the greater Boston area. Network Administrators have responsibility for both onsite and remote client support, including heavy interaction with end-users in diverse computing environments. Engineers are challenged daily working in an energetic, fast moving, collaborative, demanding & results-oriented work environment. Thrive is looking to hire individuals who demonstrate technical proficiency, have strong verbal and written communication skills and have the desire to learn and be involved in all aspects of IT. Thrive provides a unique work environment for ambitious individuals through an unparalleled diversity of work and opportunities for growth. Primary

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Analyze and document an unfamiliar client / server network environment while assessing the quickest path to resolution for a particular incident affecting the network. • Review of incident post-mortem and providing RFOs both internally and externally as necessary to inform them of resolution. • Perform rapid analysis of networking incidents and consistently demonstrate the ability to determine the cause • Ability to handle diverse infrastructure/network environments in a wide cross section of business clients • Develop client standards based on Thrive best practices and document as well as evaluate needs across client base • Troubleshoot and research infrastructure/network level issues and network level issues independently • Vast technical understanding and ability to understand escalation notes and quickly determine and resolve complicated technical issues • Monitor the service desk service board for escalated service cases • Prioritize cases escalated from Network Engineers • Ensure that open service cases are escalated and addressed appropriately from Network Engineers • Follow Thrives’ best practices for escalating cases from Network Engineers • Escalate when necessary senior most engineer for further review/troubleshooting • Work with internal teams to provide consulting to clients on infrastructure/networking best practices • Provide escalated support, mentoring, and technical leadership to other engineers in the department • While working in client environments, identify opportunities for improvement and capture those opportunities in central information system • Identify reoccurring issues that are being dealt with in the support center and develop a plan to resolve via problem management • Constant review of security best practices in relation to client environments to uncover and proactively resolve any potential risks through change management • Work directly with Team Lead to implement designated standards across customer base to improve service delivery • Resolution of incidents related to, but not limited to the following: Infrastructure/Networking issues including but not limited to: SSLVPN, Site to Site VPN, Access Rules • Design, deploy, and maintain client LANs, WANs, and wireless networks, including routers, firewalls, and switches. • Secures network system by establishing and enforcing policies and defining and monitoring access • Provide upgrade recommendations on new and existing equipment, hardware, and software upgrades • Monitor network performance and troubleshoot problem areas as needed. • Monitor and test network performance and provide network performance statistics and reports. • Updating network equipment to the latest firmware release

title: Senior System Administrator
jobDescription:
Position Overview- Senior System Adminstrators provide remote support across diverse, multi-tenant environments, handling escalated incidents and complex service requests. The role involves advanced troubleshooting, implementing changes, coordinating with other teams, and serving as an escalation point for engineers within the team, while maintaining clear client communication. Thrive seeks technically proficient professionals with strong verbal and written skills, a desire to learn across all aspects of IT, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with broad technical exposure and opportunities for growth. Responsibilities- • Take technical ownership of assigned clients, including escalated issues, ensuring resolution of infrastructure- and business-critical problems, often coordinating with clients and their vendors. • Perform third-level support and advanced troubleshooting for escalated incidents, including network, server, and workstation issues. • Evaluate client infrastructure, systems, software, and processes to identify deficiencies and recommend improvements or projects to meet client needs. • Lead major incident outages, conduct post-incident reviews, and drive corrective actions, including root cause analysis and documentation. • Identify systemic and pervasive issues, perform trend analysis, and implement permanent solutions to prevent future problems. • Design and validate multi-tenant solutions, including identity management, networking, security, disaster recovery, zero trust, hybrid AD/Entra, Intune baselines, conditional access, identity governance, complex networking/firewall policies, SASE/SWG, and SIEM integrations. • Benchmark, tune, and optimize systems for performance, capacity, and scalability. • Create and maintain documentation, network diagrams, change control approvals, and knowledge base content; write and review changes for complex tasks following established processes and industry best practices. • Develop and maintain automation and operational tools, including Power Shell modules, RMM policies, deployment pipelines, compliance checks, and monitoring improvements. • Deliver training, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to team readiness and process improvement initiatives. Required Qualifications- • 7+ years in IT operations/engineering with MSP or large enterprise experience. • Expertise in identity, networking, cloud, security, and automation. • Deep experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra, Exchange/M365 admin, Intune, and Share Point. • Proven leadership in major incidents and complex transformations. • Strong documentation and stakeholder communication; executive-ready briefings. • Excellent written and verbal communication, documentation, and time-management skills. • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. • Availability to work after hours or participate in on-call rotations as required. • Excellent customer service skills Optional
